name: Pigeon River Fund

funder.name: Community Foundation of Western North Carolina

summary: Grants for projects that improve streams and rivers in Haywood, Buncombe and Madison counties, North Carolina, through better water quality, fish and wildlife habitat, public access or awareness.

geography.label: Haywood, Buncombe and Madison counties, North Carolina

reporting: Grantees submit an online end-of-grant report verifying use of funds and results.

calls.label: Twice-yearly rounds
calls.recurring: Complete applications due 5 p.m. on March 15 and September 15

status.quote: Applications are considered twice a year, with complete applications due to CFWNC by 5 p.m. on March 15 and September 15.

recurring.quote: Applications are considered twice a year, with complete applications due to CFWNC by 5 p.m. on March 15 and September 15.

applicant_types.quote: Tax-exempt organizations described in Section 501(c)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code and governmental entities serving Buncombe, Haywood or Madison counties are eligible to apply.

geography.quote: The Pigeon River Fund (PRF) exists to improve the streams and rivers of Haywood, Buncombe and Madison counties.

access.quote: Begin the online application process to submit a grant application.

window.quote: Applications are considered twice a year, with complete applications due to CFWNC by 5 p.m. on March 15 and September 15.

amount.quote: Grants are typically for one year and generally range from $5,000 to $35,000.

reporting.quote: Applicants must submit an online end-of-grant report verifying use of grant funds and results.
